item.title: Water Contamination Crisis Claims 10 Lives in Indore
item.description: A severe water contamination outbreak in Indore’s Bhagirathpura area has killed 10 people and sickened over 2,000 due to sewage mixing with drinking water pipelines, prompting suspensions, compensation, and emergency measures from the Madhya Pradesh government. item.title: Delhi Chokes Under Toxic Air as Pollution Persists Into New Year
item.description: Delhi began 2026 shrouded in toxic smog, with “very poor” air quality persisting for months and underscoring the capital’s entrenched winter pollution crisis despite years of emergency measures. item.title: Not Rankings, India’s Real Economic Test Is GDP per Capita
item.description: When former chief economist of IMF Geeta Gopinath highlighted India’s rapid rise in global GDP rankings at Davos, the applause was predictable—and understandable. India becoming the world’s fourth- or fifth-largest economy is no small achievement. The post Not Rankings, India’s Real Economic Test Is GDP per Capita appeared first on THE NEW INDIAN.

item.title: Trilateral Talks in Abu Dhabi Stall Amid Ongoing Ukraine War
item.description: The first trilateral peace negotiations between Ukraine, Russia, and the United States concluded their initial session without a breakthrough, as deep divisions over occupied territories in eastern Ukraine overshadowed discussions. item.title: Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Canada Over Trade Deal with China
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump issued a stark warning to Canada on Saturday, threatening to impose a 100% tariff on all Canadian goods imported into the United States if Ottawa proceeds with a recently announced trade deal with China. The ultimatum, delivered via a post on Truth Social, escalates tensions between the two longtime allies amid broader U.S. efforts to curb Chinese economic influence. The post Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Canada Over Trade Deal with China appeared first on THE NEW I

item.title: Ursula von der Leyen Visits New Delhi to finalize India-EU FTA
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen arrived in New Delhi on Saturday for high-level talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, as India and the European Union move closer to concluding a long-pending Free Trade Agreement (FTA) that both sides have described as a strategic priority. The post Ursula von der Leyen Visits New Delhi to finalize India-EU FTA appeared first on THE NEW INDIAN.

item.title: India-EU Summit Seals Historic Free Trade Agreement
item.description: India and the European Union on Monday finalized a landmark Free Trade Agreement (FTA) at the 16th India-EU Summit. The deal is poised to double bilateral trade from its current €120 billion in goods and €59.7 billion in services to over €250 billion within a decade. The post India-EU Summit Seals Historic Free Trade Agreement appeared first on THE NEW INDIAN.

item.title: China’s Military Purge Hits Top Brass
item.description: China’s ongoing anti-corruption drive has escalated into its most dramatic military purge in decades, targeting top generals. The post China’s Military Purge Hits Top Brass appeared first on THE NEW INDIAN.

item.title: Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar killed in Baramati Plane Crash
item.description: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar and four others were killed this morning when the private aircraft they were traveling in crashed during landing at Baramati airport in Pune district. item.description: The US has reinforced defense cooperation and strategic alignment with India—despite ongoing bilateral tensions under President Donald Trump, marked by punitive tariffs and strained trade talks.
